text: {"summary":"Pods that have been stopped are still being considered in‑service and continue to receive traffic, leading to requests that never get a response.","likely_cause":"The termination flow is not updating the EndpointSlice correctly – terminating pods remain marked as ready (or load balancers are still routing to them) so traffic is sent to pods that have stopped responding.","confidence":"medium","next_action":"Check the pod termination process: verify that pods enter the terminating state, that their EndpointSlice entries get the `ready:false` flag and the `serving` condition is updated. Ensure readiness gates or termination hooks are configured so the pod is removed from service before it stops responding. If needed, add or adjust a Pod Disruption Budget to control how many pods can be terminated simultaneously."}
